newsitem.title: USA: Model Imperial, Quality King reach deal.
newsitem.headline: Model Imperial, Quality King reach deal.

text.p: Model Imperial Inc said Thursday it had entered into a non-binding letter agreement with Quality King Inc to complete a financing agreement designed to help it reorganize under Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.

The company said Quality King would buy the secured portion of the claim held by NationsBank South NA, fund its reorganization plan for the benefit of other creditors, and give it financing after it emerged from bankruptcy.
Quality King would also deposit sums to pay administrative and priority claims and unsecured creditors, it added.
In return, Quality King would get 90 percent of a new class of common stock to be issued by Model Imperial once it had reorganized itself, the company said.
The remaining 10 percent would be given to its other shareholders, it said. The new class would be the only outstanding class of common stock of the reorganized company, it added.
The bankruptcy court has until April 15 to approve the agreement, the company said.
Model Imperial, a wholesale distributor of brand-name fragrances, sought protection under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Florida in July.
